review.reason: The course layout, mapped hazards, tees, greens, and property silhouette are faithfully illustrated. The mapped short fairway patch for hole 3 lacks clearly readable alternating mowing stripes at thumbnail scale, so the illustration does not meet the fairway-stripe requirement.

issues.detail: The short fairway patch between T3 and G3 has no clearly distinguishable alternating light and dark bands; its turf reads mostly as uniform, mottled grass.
issues.consequence: At overview scale, this mapped landing area can blend into the surrounding rough and be less legible as fairway.
